extracted.intended_audience: patent office classification implementers and examiners (USPTO/EPO), CPC project managers, IT and training staff
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for implementing the Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) system: converting ECLA/ICO/IPC schemes to CPC symbols, mapping keywords, designing IT and QA, training staff, and launching the CPC scheme across patent offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: CPC derived from IPC-based ECLA (joint system)
rubrics_metrics.description: USPTO/EPO agreed to co-operate on a joint classification system derived from IPC-based ECLA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The system should incorporate best classification practices of the two offices and be aligned with WIPO classification standards and the IPC structure. Stakeholders should receive regular updates on partnership progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include ECLA/ICO subdivisions
rubrics_metrics.description: CPC will include: ECLA/ICO subdivisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keywords are mapped first to ECLA/ICO and then to CPC; ICOs (including mirrored and breakdowns) are to be included in the CPC scheme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keywords conversion: keywords first to ECLA/ICO then to CPC
rubrics_metrics.description: Keywords are converted via ICO/ECLA into CPC codes (keyword-to-ICO conversion).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show mapping of EC/ICO keyword codes to final CPC 2000-series codes (e.g., B29C2849/0043 -> B29C2849/0043 -> final CPC B29C2849/0043). Maintain traceability of keyword origin.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include USPTO special areas and special collections
rubrics_metrics.description: CPC will include USPTO special areas, e.g. business methods, and special collections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special topical areas maintained by USPTO must be representable in CPC so that existing special collections and business-method related classifications are preserved in the new scheme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preserve hierarchical structure of ECLA (dots)
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain the hierarchical structure of ECLA (dots) within CPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subdivision and hierarchy semantics of ECLA should be preserved when converted to CPC numbering so that parent/child relationships remain clear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capability to expand (future revisions)
rubrics_metrics.description: CPC must have capability to expand for future revisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design numbering and allocation so new subdivisions and future changes can be accommodated without breaking existing structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: CPC Definitions at least to the main group level
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide CPC Definitions at least to the main group level.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document classification practices (CPC Definitions) so classifiers and examiners have authoritative guidance; definitions should be prepared as part of transition and maintained thereafter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocation standard compatible with WIPO Standard 8
rubrics_metrics.description: Allocations standard for CPC must be compatible with WIPO's Standard 8.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure numbering and allocation practices conform to WIPO conventions to maintain interoperability with international classification standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion algorithm: use IPC-type numbering (no letter after '/')
rubrics_metrics.description: CPC will use IPC-type numbering; CPC symbols will not have any letter after the “/” (example: H01L21/02A1H becomes H01L21/0217).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply a deterministic conversion algorithm from ECLA to CPC symbols that yields IPC-style numeric extensions after the slash; document and implement the algorithm consistently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classify invention and additional information using CPC symbols
rubrics_metrics.description: Invention and Additional information will be classified using CPC symbols.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both the primary invention disclosure and any additional informational indexing must use the assigned CPC symbols for consistency in search and retrieval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep IPC part visible and retain last digit of IPC symbol during subdivision
rubrics_metrics.description: IPC part after the '/' remains visible: subdivision takes place while keeping the last digit of the corresponding IPC symbol.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When creating CPC subdivisions from ECLA/ICO, maintain the original IPC group digit so the IPC anchor is preserved (examples shown converting H01L21/027 series to a sequence of H01L21/02709, 02718, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Include IPC groups directly in CPC
rubrics_metrics.description: IPC groups are to be included in the CPC scheme unchanged where appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some IPC group symbols map directly into CPC (examples show identical IPC->CPC entries such as H01L21/285 -> H01L21/285).

rubrics_metrics.name: Include ECLA groups and renumber to CPC
rubrics_metrics.description: ECLA groups are to be included and renumbered into CPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ECLA group series (including multi-level letters) are converted into numeric CPC extensions (examples: H01L21/285B4A -> H01L21/28504, 28508, etc.). Maintain mapping so original ECLA granularity is preserved in CPC numeric scheme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include mirrored and breakdown ICO groups; convert ICO section symbols
rubrics_metrics.description: Include mirrored (& breakdowns) ICO groups in CPC and convert ICO Section symbol T to ECLA Section symbol H (and analogous conversions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mirrored ICO entries (T-prefixed) are mapped to ECLA/H-section equivalents and then renumbered into CPC. Preserve mirrored/breakdown structure when creating CPC entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Renumbering scheme for ICO-derived groups (CPC 2000 series)
rubrics_metrics.description: ICO codes (orthogonal series) are renumbered into CPC 2000-series format (examples: T01L925/065 -> H01L2925/065 -> H01L2925/06504 etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the renumbering pattern to produce final CPC codes that embed ICO orthogonal identifiers in a consistent numeric format (keep ICO section conversion and numeric extension conventions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Keyword to CPC 2000-series conversion with section-letter mapping
rubrics_metrics.description: Keywords mapped via ICO are converted into CPC 2000-series with ICO section letter converted to ECLA section letter as part of the final CPC code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples illustrate converting keyword codes and ICO section letters to final CPC codes (e.g., c04900c2pb02 -> ICO L29C849/0043 -> final CPC B29C2849/0043). Ensure section-letter translation rules are applied consistently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record classification/indexing origins
rubrics_metrics.description: Classification/Indexing origin must record source(s): IPC, ECLA, mirrored ICO, breakdowns of mirrored ICO, orthogonal ICO, ICO originating from keywords.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain provenance metadata for each CPC entry so users can trace the origin of each classification to IPC/ECLA/ICO/keyword sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop training for CPC
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop training materials and conduct training for classifiers and examiners as part of CPC transition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training is a key transition activity; plan, document, and deliver training before and after launch to ensure consistent application of CPC Definitions and conversion rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document classification practices (create CPC Definitions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Document classification practices by preparing CPC Definitions to guide consistent classification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CPC Definitions should be prepared at least to the main group level and cover conversion/assignment rules, examples, and use cases for classifiers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perform keyword to ICO conversion operationally
rubrics_metrics.description: Operationally convert keywords into ICO codes as part of building the CPC scheme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This activity combines lexical/terminology work with mapping rules; ensure mappings are tested and validated against a representative document set.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carry out ECLA housekeeping
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform ECLA housekeeping to prepare ECLA content for conversion to CPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Housekeeping includes cleaning up ECLA entries, resolving redundancies, and ensuring consistent source data prior to automated conversion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design IT systems and a collaborative environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Design IT infrastructure and a collaborative environment to implement and maintain CPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IT design must support conversion algorithms, storage of CPC definitions, collaborative editing, and distribution; plan for joint tools usable by both offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implement IT at USPTO and EPO and conduct collaborative workflows
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement the designed IT at USPTO and EPO and establish collaborative operational workflows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate deployments and workflows between offices to support joint maintenance, revisions, and daily classification work.

rubrics_metrics.name: CPC scheme launch: publish launch version and prepare for launch
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare and make the CPC Scheme launch version publicly available (target dates shown: public availability 1 October 2012, launch operational 1 Jan 2013).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare communications, documentation, and conversion deliverables (including backfile conversion) to meet public launch and operational dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convert EPO backfile to CPC
rubrics_metrics.description: Convert the EPO backfile to CPC as part of preparing for CPC launch.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan large-scale retrospective conversion of existing records; ensure QA and mapping provenance are maintained during backfile conversion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish a Quality Assurance process
rubrics_metrics.description: Have a Quality Assurance process in place for CPC conversion and use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: QA should cover conversion accuracy, classification consistency, IT system checks, and ongoing monitoring post-launch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Harmonize classification practices and perform joint CPC revisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Achieve harmonized classification practices between offices and establish processes for joint CPC revisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set governance and revision procedures so both offices apply CPC consistently and update the scheme collaboratively over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make CPC available for use by other IP offices
rubrics_metrics.description: Make the CPC available for use by other IP offices beyond USPTO and EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide documentation, tools, and outreach so other offices can adopt CPC and align their classification practices with the joint scheme.
